cross_run_audit.purpose: audit whether the same frozen seed reproduces identical visible paper carrier data across independent CI runs
cross_run_audit.interpretation: paper-v7 is fully traceable within each generated artifact and preserves the same payload/E5/high-level paper story, but the visible current V18/V20 carrier data are not yet numerically identical across independent fresh runs with the same seed. Cross-run visible-carrier determinism therefore remains an explicit system-level gap.

accepted_claims: one current V20 package can be rendered into four non-empty synthetic figures and twelve raw-data CSV tables with machine-verifiable hashes
Figure 2 representative selection follows the frozen highest-confidence-per-morphology rule
Figure 3 matched-fit values equal the current paper-v6 machine analysis and its linear baselines are recomputed from the same visible current curves
Figure 4 uses the same current-V20 E5 machine result that completed paper E5
C1, C2, C4 and C5 are explicitly traced to figures, raw data and/or current machine evidence
the final paper-v7 bundle manifest covers every pre-existing paper-v7 file and independently recomputes without mismatch
not_supported: cross-run numerical identity of the visible carrier for a fixed seed
undetectability or cryptographic security of the numeric carrier
optimal carrier rate or parity overhead
next_system_level_gap: make the current visible carrier numerically deterministic across independent runs without changing the audited protocol meaning or tuning carrier performance
